description: A six by three crossbar switch with eighteen stored routings and a set of per-output functions, all worked from one mode button

params.text: In green mode this connects its own input to its own output; in red mode it recalls the routing stored under it; in blue mode it turns on one of that output's six functions
Steps the module between green routing, red recall and blue function modes, and lights in the colour of the mode it is in

inputs.text: One of the six signals the crossbar can route to any output

outputs.text: The sum of the inputs switched to it, after any of that column's functions have been applied

notes: nothing reaches an output until buttons are pressed in green mode; a new module has every crossing and every function off
the six functions on a column, in button order, are: multiply the selected inputs instead of adding them; fold anything past 5V back through 25 divided by itself; and invert
the last three of a column's six functions, in button order, are: raise two to the signal; take the cube root of 25 times the signal; and block DC
each button's lamp mixes three colours at once: red marks the routing that button stores, green a crossing that is on, and blue a function that is on
